vBRIEFInfo.description: AGENTS.md reduction round 2: de-duplicate the maintainer half against the managed section (#2183) and reduce verbose managed-section-template rationale/duplication (#2184), then ratchet the #645 budget down.

plan.title: refactor(agents-md): de-duplicate maintainer half + reduce managed-section template

narratives.Description: The maintainer AGENTS.md restated ~70% of the managed section (Returning Sessions, Deft Alignment Confirmation, Session-start ritual, Implementation Intent Gate, Story Start Gate) in full prose (#2183). The managed-section template also carried verbose mechanism paragraphs that propagate to every consumer (#2184). Both were collapsed to the established #2156 'Same rules as the managed section below; substitute task for deft' pointer pattern, preserving every #1309 propagation marker (commands, policy keys, headers, action verbs) and the #645 ratchet.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. #2184: collapse the template Session-start ritual's three mechanism paragraphs (doctor internals / bootstrap narrative / triage-welcome internals) to one pointer; collapse the Branch Policy Disclosure override-paths list to a pointer to the Branch policy section above. Run agents:refresh to regenerate the AGENTS.md managed section. 2. #2183: collapse the five fully-duplicated maintainer behavioral sections to the #2156 pointer pattern, retaining the required task-form command markers (task session:start, task verify:tools, task doctor, task scope:promote/activate/complete, git status --short --branch, task xbrief:preflight) and the ### Story Start Gate header. 3. Ratchet plan.policy.agentsMdBudget down (managed 205->198, unmanaged 266->226). 4. Contract test tests/content/test_agents_entry_contract.py (TS port) must stay green; run task check.
narratives.UserStory: As an agent loading AGENTS.md, I want the maintainer half and managed template to state each rule once (with a pointer to the canonical copy) instead of restating it, so the always-loaded context is smaller and more legible.

narrative.Acceptance: Returning Sessions, Deft Alignment Confirmation, Session-start ritual, Implementation Intent Gate, Story Start Gate collapse to the #2156 pointer pattern; all required task-form markers preserved.
Template Session-start ritual mechanism paragraphs + Branch Policy Disclosure override list collapse to pointers; agents:refresh regenerates AGENTS.md; consumer markers preserved.
plan.policy.agentsMdBudget lowered to new actuals; contract test green; task check passes; CHANGELOG entry added.
